fields.position: Parallel listwise reranking splits candidates into groups with fixed advancement quotas. Contiguous chunks crowd strong retriever-prefix documents into one group, so a better retriever can suffer more quota cuts. DealRank deals candidates round-robin by retriever rank to balance every prefix, then ranks groups concurrently and advances quotas into a final merge without repair certification.
fields.tradeoff: HVMap changes cross-space candidate mapping/scoring. DealRank does not train representations; it schedules existing candidates into ranker calls. They can compose in a retrieval pipeline, but fewer calls do not establish better alignment, and correct SCORE2 does not prove lossless listwise quotas.
